marketing_description: The Makita XNB07Z LXT Series 18 V brushless cordless framing nailer operates on an LXT Lithium-Ion battery and delivers up to 750 nails per charge using a 5.0Ah battery. This tool features a 30-degree strip magazine with a capacity of 84 clipping nails ranging from 2 to 3-1/2 in length, 7/62 to 0.131 in diameter, and 30 ga. It includes selectable sequential or bump fire actuation, tool-less depth adjustment, a built-in L.E.D. light, and Extreme Protection Technology for improved dust and water resistance.
